### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window Bounds:** 0,0 to 1024,768 (Maximized).
*   **Title Bar:** [0,0] to [1024,55]. Contains app branding (left) and global actions/window controls (right).
*   **Sidebar (Navigation):** [0,56] to [280,940]. Vertical list of categorized tools.
    *   **Section: Data Recovery** [10,95] to [270,335].
    *   **Section: Advanced Features** [10,370] to [270,525].
    *   **Section: File Backup** [10,560] to [270,650].
*   **Main Content Area:** [285,56] to [1024,940]. White background container.
    *   **Header Region:** [310,90] to [900,170]. Title and subtitle.
    *   **Grid Region:** [310,230] to [860,850]. 2-column grid of feature cards.
*   **Windows Taskbar:** [0,941] to [1024,768]. System UI at bottom.

**Grid/Alignment Observations:**
*   Sidebar items are left-aligned with a consistent 24px left padding.
*   Main content uses a 2-column grid with ~20px gutters and ~20px row gaps.
*   Cards are uniform in width (~265px) and height (~195px).

---

### 2. TEXT
**Title Bar:**
*   `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free` [45,18]

**Sidebar:**
*   `Data Recovery` [18,105]
*   `Hardware Disk` [65,158]
*   `SD Card` [65,228]
*   `More Recovery Tools` [65,298]
*   `Advanced Features` [18,380]
*   `File Repair` [65,433]
*   `Lost Partition Rescue` [65,503]
*   `File Backup` [18,570]
*   `ChronoSnap Backup` [65,623]

**Main Content:**
*   **Header:**
    *   `More Recovery Tools` [310,105]
    *   `Tackle complex data loss with our advanced recovery tools.` [310,155]
*   **Card 1 (Top Left):**
    *   `Crashed PC Rescue` [325,330]
    *   `Rescue data from an unbootable computer for any reason.` [325,375]
*   **Card 2 (Top Right):**
    *   `NAS and Linux` [600,330]
    *   `Easily recover your NAS and Linux data.` [600,375]
*   **Card 3 (Mid Left):**
    *   `RAID Recovery` [325,560]
    *   `Automatically detect and recover RAID data.` [325,605]
*   **Card 4 (Mid Right):**
    *   `Cloud Recovery` [600,560]
    *   `Recover your lost or deleted data from Cloud drives.` [600,605]
*   **Card 5 (Bot Left):**
    *   `Image Recovery` [325,770]
    *   `Create and restore full images of physical drives and virtual machines.` [325,815]
*   **Card 6 (Bot Right):**
    *   `Disk Health` [600,770]
    *   `Check disk before recovery.` [600,815]

**Taskbar:**
*   `Search` [335,962]
*   `7:59 PM` [925,952]
*   `10/17/2026` [915,972]

---

### 3. COLOR
*   **Window Background (Sidebar):** `#F5F8FC` (Light Blue-Grey)
*   **Main Surface Background:** `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Selected Sidebar Item Background:** `#E6F0FF` (Light Blue)
*   **Primary Text (Headings/Selected Item):** `#1F1F1F` (Near Black)
*   **Secondary Text (Descriptions/Sidebar Labels):** `#666666` or `#555555` (Dark Grey)
*   **Accent Color (Icons/Selection):** `#2B7AFA` (Bright Blue)
*   **Success Indicator (Checkmark):** #00C853 (Green)
*   **Borders (Cards):** `#E0E0E0` or `#DDDDDD` (Light Grey)
*   **Icon Backgrounds (in cards):** `#F0F2F5` (Very Light Grey)

---

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **App Title (Title Bar):** Segoe UI / System Font, ~11px, Regular.
*   **Sidebar Section Headers:** Segoe UI, ~12px, Regular, Grey.
*   **Sidebar Items:** Segoe UI, ~13px, Regular.
*   **Main Heading ("More Recovery Tools"):** Segoe UI, ~24px-28px, Semi-Bold/Bold.
*   **Subheading (Description):** Segoe UI, ~13px-14px, Regular, Grey.
*   **Card Titles:** Segoe UI, ~16px-18px, Semi-Bold.
*   **Card Descriptions:** Segoe UI, ~12px-13px, Regular, Grey.

---

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~280px.
*   **Card Dimensions:** Width ~265px, Height ~195px.
*   **Card Border Radius:** ~8px - 10px.
*   **Card Internal Padding:** ~20px.
*   **Icon Container Size (Cards):** ~48x48px, Radius ~8px.
*   **Sidebar Item Height:** ~44px.
*   **Grid Gap:** ~20px (Horizontal & Vertical).
*   **Title Bar Height:** ~50px.

---

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Sidebar List Item (`More Recovery Tools`):** State = **Selected**. Indicated by light blue background and blue text/icon.
*   **Sidebar List Item (`Hardware Disk`):** State = **Normal** with **Success Badge** (Green checkmark icon on right).
*   **Feature Cards:** State = **Normal/Hoverable**. Appear as clickable buttons/tiles.
*   **Window Controls (Top Right):**
    *   Minimize Button
    *   Maximize/Restore Button
    *   Close (X) Button

---

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, "Fluent" style (rounded corners, soft fills), mostly Outline or Two-tone.
*   **Sidebar Icons:** Filled or heavy outline, ~24px.
    *   Hardware Disk: Grid icon.
    *   SD Card: SD card shape.
    *   More Recovery Tools: Puzzle piece/Wrench combo.
    *   File Repair: Folder with tool.
    *   Lost Partition: Circular arrow/gear.
    *   ChronoSnap: Clock/History icon.
*   **Card Icons:** Placed inside a light grey rounded square container.
    *   Crashed PC Rescue: Monitor with warning triangle.
    *   NAS/Linux: Server rack.
    *   RAID: Stack of disks.
    *   Cloud: Cloud with arrow.
    *   Image: Stack of drives/disks.
    *   Disk Health: Disk with heartbeat line.

---

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Success/Ready**. The application is fully loaded, displaying the "More Recovery Tools" sub-page. No loading spinners, empty states, or error messages are visible.
*   **Context:** The user has navigated to the "More Recovery Tools" section from the main Data Recovery view. The "Hardware Disk" item in the sidebar suggests a previous successful action or active connection (indicated by the green check).
